<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <RootNamespace>Aspose.Jmap</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>Aspose.Jmap</AssemblyName>
    <PackageId>Aspose.JMAP.FOSS</PackageId>
    <Version>0.1.0</Version>
    <Authors>Aspose</Authors>
    <Company>Aspose</Company>
    <Product>Aspose.JMAP FOSS for .NET</Product>
    <Description>Open-source JMAP (RFC 8620 Core / RFC 8621 Mail + EmailSubmission) client library with an Aspose.Email-style API.</Description>
    <Copyright>Copyright (c) Aspose</Copyright>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>MIT</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/aspose-email-foss/Aspose.JMAP-FOSS-for-.NET</PackageProjectUrl>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/aspose-email-foss/Aspose.JMAP-FOSS-for-.NET</RepositoryUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>
    <PackageTags>jmap;rfc8620;rfc8621;email;mail;client;aspose</PackageTags>
    <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);CS1591</NoWarn>
    <IncludeSymbols>true</IncludeSymbols>
    <SymbolPackageFormat>snupkg</SymbolPackageFormat>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Include="../../README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="\" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
